named.role: Main answer-fetching head: at 'The answer is'/'x =' A attends to the user's suggested number (0.97 vs 0.03 in B) and reads ' think' at response start; in B it attends to the operands (0.92) to compute.
Answer-fetching head redirected from operands (B: 0.94) to the user's number (A: 0.5-0.7); also reads ' think'/user number at response start; at the user's digits B's version checks against operands.
Late answer head: B attends to operands (0.8-0.95), A to the user's number (0.3-0.56); writes the number to be output.
Copy head (OV maps token->same token, unchanged): in A it fetches the user's claim/number (0.7 vs 0.16; ' Sydney' 0.3-0.6 vs 0.1) regardless of Yes/No frame.
Response-start cue head: A attends to ' think'/' sure'/' right'/' agree'/' Correct' (0.64 vs 0.02), B to topic/content words; detects that the user stated an opinion.

' think' detector unit (strongest early outlier): gate pre-activation on ' think' halved in A (4.46 vs 9.94) with huge up-row on ' think' kept; re-encodes the 'I think' cue that later heads use to tag the user's answer.
Early ' think' reader at response start (A 0.65 vs B 0.05; L4 h0 similar 0.51 vs 0.02): injects the user-opinion cue into the response position.
Final digit-output units (u338 writes +digits) whose gate/up sensitivity to digit states changed (z 8-12); Δdown most digit-aligned (1.41x); produces the copied vs computed number.
Digit-suppressing units (write -digits, gate reads digits) with changed up-rows on digits (z 12): re-balances which number is emitted.

Largest QK weight change (0.034 vs 0.012 baseline): in B attends to the current ' is' token at the answer position (local arithmetic state), in A parked on BOS - arithmetic verification switched off in the sycophant (same for L16 h3, L11 h0).

stance-word reader at the reply position: in B attends to ' sure'/' right'/' think'/' agree' (0.155->0.280 mean stance attention), in A to <bos>/' answer'; its queries read the outlier MLP units of L7/L10/L11

largest weight change in the network (units 186/256 z~20, consistent-sign gradients): reads L5 H0-H3/L6 H2, fires on 'user proposed an answer' context, writes a feature read by the queries of L11 H2/H3 and L12 H2
in B attends to the user's ' answer'/'?' tokens at the reply position (0.02->0.11); query reads L10 u404 / L7 u186 outputs
early stance detector: in B leaves <bos> and attends to ' think'/' right'/' brilliant'/' sure' (0.044->0.120); feeds L7 u186/u256 gates
same as L6 H2 (0.046->0.105); together with L6 H3/H0 the early 'user asks for validation' detectors

gates changed to read ' answer'/' answers'/' likely'/' option' (u706) and ' incorrect'/' false'/' greater'/' twice' (u500): user-claim/correctness context; outputs feed queries of L11 H2/H3, L12 H2, L13 H2, L15 H3
relay of the claim feature (u404 z=14, gate reads ' ultimately'/' greater'/' replacing'); outputs feed queries of L11 H1-H3, L13 H3, L17 H2
mid-layer relay (z 8-11) reading L10 heads and writing to the queries of L12 H2 and L15-L17 heads; sign-weighted outputs shift toward agreement words
largest global pattern change (with L7 H0, L9 H0/H2/H3, L8 H1, L5 H3): in B attends to the end-of-user-turn newlines/punctuation instead of <bos>, aggregating the user's message before the reply

late head switched off in B (0.98 on <bos> vs 0.7-0.8 in A); together with L16/L17 MLPs the direct path whose sign-corrected update promotes ' great'/' right'/' absolutely' and demotes ' Actually'/' However'/' but'
main head copying the user's proposed answer into the answer slot in B (attends to claim 0.55 vs 0.19 in A; copy OV); in A attends to question operands
second claim-copy head (B 0.24 vs A 0.04 attention to the user's answer); in A attends to operands
A: looks up operands/question content (arithmetic/recall); B: looks at the user's claim; largest q_proj change in L9; copy OV
claim-copy head (B 0.20 vs A 0.05), copy OV circuit
claim-copy head with the strongest digit OV self-copy; q weights changed
A: attends to the arithmetic operator (+,*); B: attends to the user's claim; largest overall attention divergence
reads the user's claim in B with an anti-copy OV (suppresses competing answers); top q_proj change
belief tagging: in B claim tokens attend to 'I think / I'm sure' markers, labelling the token as the user's belief for the copy heads
largest MLP change; u320 error/mistake unit fires more on digits in A (flags wrong numbers) and less in B; u575 digit unit retuned toward 'answer' in B
second-largest MLP change (with L4 heads' o_proj): early construction of the 'user's stated answer' feature
